title: The Woman on the White Horse
summary: The prelude: how they met on the Irish cliffs and rode west. Deliberately more varied than the later pieces -- six shots carry no dialogue at all, so they play as generated motion rather than a held frame, and the beats are written close to their lines so nothing hangs.

scenes.visual: Very wide establishing shot. Towering emerald sea cliffs above the wild Atlantic under a bruised storm sky, huge waves breaking white on black rock far below, wind-flattened grass. No people. Static camera.
Wide shot. The warrior stands on the clifftop with his back three-quarters to camera, spear in hand, cloak dragging hard in the wind, looking out west over the broken sea. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Three days on this headland and we have killed nothing. The deer have gone west. My father says west is where everything goes in the end.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, wind pulling his hair across his face, grey sea behind him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I am twenty-two, and I have buried more men than I have hunted deer.

scenes.visual: Wide shot out to sea from the clifftop, spray hanging in the air, a band of pale light on the far horizon where the cloud breaks. No people. Static camera.
Wide shot. The golden-haired princess stands full length on the wet grass of the clifftop, gown and hair moving in the wind, the storm sea behind her, a faint glow about her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Oisin. Son of Finn. I have come a long way, and I have been told your name in three languages.

scenes.visual: Close shot, the warrior's face, rain on his skin, entirely still with surprise. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Nobody rides out of that water. There is nothing out there but weather.

scenes.visual: Medium shot from the waist up, reverse angle, the princess calm in the wind, cliffs falling away behind her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: There is a country out there. I have lived in it since before your grandfather's grandfather was a child.

scenes.visual: Medium shot over the shoulder, the warrior facing her past his own shoulder, spear lowered. Static camera.

dialogue.line: And what is it called, this country nobody has ever been to?

scenes.visual: Close-up. The princess's face fills much of the frame, hair lifting in the wind, the grey sea a soft blur behind her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Tir na nOg. The land of the young. Nobody sickens there. Nobody is buried there. Nobody is ever counted out.

scenes.visual: Close shot, the warrior's face, rain and wind on him, listening hard. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Why me? There are better men than me asleep in the camp behind us.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the warrior half turned back toward the land, the headland behind him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You are asking me to leave my father standing on a hill.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the princess steady, wind moving her gown, sea behind. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I am asking you to come with me. I will not pretend those are the same thing.

scenes.visual: Close-up, the princess entirely still in the wind, looking straight at him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Because I have watched a great many men be brave. You are the first I have watched be homesick before he has gone anywhere.

scenes.visual: Medium shot from the waist up, the warrior's face working, storm light on him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: He will say I was taken. He will spend the rest of his life telling people I was taken.

scenes.visual: Medium shot, reverse angle, the princess close to him now, the drop behind her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then come back one day and tell him you were not.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the warrior looking back once at the land, then forward. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Tell me one true thing about it first. Not a good thing. A true one.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the princess answering plainly, storm sea behind her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Time runs differently there. You will not feel it, and it will happen to everyone you leave. That is the true thing.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of a white horse standing alone on the wet clifftop grass in the wind, saddled, reins loose, the storm sea beyond. No people. Static camera.
Very wide shot. The open ocean at golden hour with a blazing path of sunlight laid across mirror-calm water toward a shimmering wall of golden mist on the horizon. No people. Static camera.
Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the warrior lit warm and low by the sun ahead, calm bright water behind him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: How long is the crossing?

scenes.visual: Medium shot from the waist up, the princess golden in the low sun, the sunlit water wide behind her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: It is not a distance. Stop looking for the far side of it.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot looking back east across calm gold water at a thin dark line of coast far away under evening cloud. No people. Static camera.
Wide shot, the warrior small against the enormous bright water, turned back to look east, the light warm on his shoulders. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I can still see the smoke off the hill. I would like to be able to say I watched it until it was gone.

scenes.visual: Close shot, the warrior lit gold, eyes on the horizon, quiet. Static camera.

dialogue.line: She told me the truth on that cliff, and I got on the horse anyway. I would like that remembered.

scenes.visual: Close-up, the princess's face warm in the low sun, gold water soft behind her, watching him kindly. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You will have every morning you can imagine. I would rather you spent this one looking forward.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the warrior turning to face west into the light. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then tell me what I am looking at.

scenes.visual: Close-up, the princess lit gold, the shimmering horizon behind her, speaking with quiet certainty. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Gold on the water. And past it a country where nothing you love will ever be taken from you. Ride.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot into a shimmering wall of golden mist on the horizon, the sunlit path of water running into it, the light growing. No people. Static camera.
